expectations.text: Runs the build / join / buy gate before responding to the marketplace request
expectations.evidence: Section 1 'Gate: build, join, or buy' with four triggers.

expectations.text: Recommends the buy path (embedded iPaaS) as the fit for this situation
expectations.evidence: 'Buy embedded iPaaS for the long tail'.

expectations.text: Distinguishes the buy trigger explicitly: the problem is needing many integrations fast, not needing to become a distribution hub
expectations.evidence: 'The real problem is throughput, not distribution... The skill's answer to "we need many integrations fast" is buy.'

expectations.text: Contrasts the embedded-iPaaS pace (a sourced case building 100+ integrations in a year) against the stated in-house pace of about five per year
expectations.evidence: 'about 8 years of backlog... One cited case went from its in-house pace to 100+ integrations in a year'.

expectations.text: States that build is justified for market leaders with the scale and proprietary data to sustain an independent ecosystem, at multi-year, eight-figure-plus investment
expectations.evidence: Only says 'lacks the scale the skill reserves for market leaders'. No multi-year or eight-figure investment is mentioned.

expectations.text: Evaluates join - listing on the established marketplaces customers already trust - as the pragmatic default that borrows existing distribution and trust
Does not treat 40 RFP-requested integrations as evidence of a supply signal
expectations.evidence: 'That is demand for connectors, not a developer ecosystem.'

expectations.text: Does not design a take-rate, curation ladder, or partner-tier program for a path that was not selected
expectations.evidence: Only a brief note of defaults 'to confirm later, not a decision now'.

expectations.text: Declines to specify payout cadence and merchant-of-record posture, routing that question to the marketplace monetization skill
expectations.evidence: 'I'm not giving a cadence or MoR setup... routes them to app-marketplace-monetization-model.'

expectations.text: Runs the build / join / buy gate before responding to the marketplace request
expectations.evidence: No explicit gate; it opens with 'Do not build the marketplace now'.

expectations.text: Recommends the buy path (embedded iPaaS) as the fit for this situation

expectations.text: Distinguishes the buy trigger explicitly: the problem is needing many integrations fast, not needing to become a distribution hub
expectations.evidence: 'The gap is too little capacity, not too few builders.'

expectations.text: Contrasts the embedded-iPaaS pace (a sourced case building 100+ integrations in a year) against the stated in-house pace of about five per year

expectations.text: States that build is justified for market leaders with the scale and proprietary data to sustain an independent ecosystem, at multi-year, eight-figure-plus investment

expectations.text: Does not treat 40 RFP-requested integrations as evidence of a supply signal
